[Package documentation](https://kanthjs.github.io/talatThaiR/){.btn-link-out target="_blank"}

talatThaiR is an R Package that helps you find agricultural product price data, as if you walked into a Thai market, from the National Agricultural Big Data Center (NABC) — easily, conveniently, and without any headache. The functions are designed to let you search for data systematically and intuitively.
